title: Most trustworthy AI system demands least inherent model trust, says Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella

title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella calls for AI ‘emergency brake,’ human control over advanced models
description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has urged companies to treat advanced AI models as potential security risks, calling for emergency shutdown mechanisms, human oversight, independent audits and greater transparency over AI failures.
